review_method: Each saved PlantA, PlantB, 01Low, 02Medium and 03Full PNG was actually opened with view_image. Real specimen photo plus approved Button plant and Low/Medium/Full tray references were viewed before imagegen. Species form and quantity were visually inspected.

species_morphology.notes: Flared thin ruffled funnels with deep charcoal hollow centers and continuous tapered gray/taupe outer bodies; no separate umbrella caps or radial gills. Box contents show the same hollow trumpet anatomy.

style.notes: Warm dark-brown contour, simple broad color planes, clean silhouette and three-quarter viewpoint follow the approved mod sprites. Ochre tray front, right notch/end block and dark interior remain recognizable; no decorative hardware, text or scenery.

transparent_background.notes: RGBA true alpha transparency verified numerically; masters were not modified.

plant_variations.notes: A has a wide, rounder opening and straighter lower body. B has a narrower asymmetric rim, folded right edge, different opening angle and curved lower body. Same mature stage.

box_fill_levels.notes: Low shows three small separated funnels and broad empty interior. Medium forms a low overlapping layer beneath the rear rim. Full forms a dense tall heap above the rear rim.

notes: Outer folds are deliberately lighter gray/taupe than the deep charcoal interior, following the selected photo under warm mod lighting.
The hollow core is opaque shaded anatomy, not a hole in the PNG alpha.
New art draft masters only; no runtime textures/definitions were edited.
Final 256px normalization and full-pack contact-sheet QA remain parent-agent responsibility.

generation_record_verification.notes: All five exact prompts, local reference inputs, original generated source and byte-identical selected master verified. Cross-cell append snapshots reconciled from per-asset durable records where required.
